data.name: FineTuning.EndpointHelp
data.value: Create a Worker profile here with its alias, private endpoint and timeout (1–300 seconds). On the NCF host, enable SenparcXncfAIKernel:FineTuning:Enabled, allow the endpoint host in AllowedHosts, and set WorkerApiKeys:<alias> to the worker's NCF_WORKER_KEY (at least 32 characters). Legacy WorkerEndpoint/WorkerApiKey settings do not configure database profiles. In Docker, localhost refers to the container, not the host. Credentials are never entered or exposed here.

data.name: FineTuning.BackendHelp
data.value: CPU is suitable for small smoke tests. CUDA needs a compatible NVIDIA GPU and CUDA-enabled worker/container. MLX runs natively on macOS Apple Silicon; a Linux Docker container cannot access Apple's Metal/MLX backend. Start a native MLX worker and configure a reachable endpoint. Available methods depend on the worker's reported capabilities, not on the browser.

data.name: FineTuning.SecurityHelp
data.value: Only trusted global administrators should manage training: worker data is not tenant-isolated. Keep the worker private, remove secrets and unnecessary personal data before uploading, and review model/data licenses. Endpoints are managed in Worker profiles; keys and the endpoint allowlist stay in infrastructure configuration.

data.name: FineTuning.AwaitingHealth
data.value: Worker capabilities are not available yet.

data.name: FineTuning.PreflightHelp
data.value: Capability availability does not guarantee sufficient memory or successful training. Check the selected model/backend/method and start with the default 10-step smoke test.

data.name: FineTuning.DatasetHelp
data.value: Upload UTF-8 .jsonl with 2–10,000 rows and at most 2 MiB (2,097,152 bytes). Each line must contain one supported object; blank lines, JSON arrays and extra fields are rejected. The browser checks encoding, JSON syntax and row structure; worker validation remains authoritative. Datasets persist on the selected Worker.

data.name: FineTuning.ValidationHelp
data.value: Use a separate held-out dataset. Overlapping training/evaluation rows are rejected. If not selected, the worker holds out approximately 20% of distinct rows (at least one), using the seed.

data.name: FineTuning.JobsHelp

data.name: FineTuning.MetricsHelp
data.value: Resource metrics are worker-reported samples. Unsupported, missing or non-numeric values are shown as unavailable, never as zero. CPU usage may exceed 100% across multiple cores.

data.name: FineTuning.DeploymentHelp
data.value: Download and inspect the adapter, tokenizer and training configuration. Load or merge the adapter with the exact base model using a compatible inference runtime, then test it before deployment. Artifacts are not automatically registered as AIKernel inference models.

data.name: FineTuning.LogHelp

data.name: FineTuning.CancelConfirm

data.name: FineTuning.CancelRequested

data.name: FineTuning.Tip.epochs
data.value: Full passes through the dataset (1–100). maxSteps overrides this when positive.

data.name: FineTuning.Tip.maxSteps
data.value: 0 uses epochs; a positive value caps optimizer steps (up to 1,000,000). Default 10 is a smoke test, not a production training run.

data.name: FineTuning.Tip.batchSize
data.value: Examples per device per micro-batch (1–64). Larger values require more memory.

data.name: FineTuning.Tip.gradientAccumulationSteps
data.value: Micro-batches accumulated per optimizer step (1–1,024). Effective batch size increases without allocating one large batch.

data.name: FineTuning.Tip.maxSequenceLength
data.value: Token limit per example (32–32,768). Long examples may be truncated; larger limits require more memory.

data.name: FineTuning.Tip.loraRank
data.value: Low-rank adapter dimension (1–256). Larger ranks increase trainable parameters and memory use.

data.name: FineTuning.Tip.loraAlpha
data.value: Adapter scaling factor (1–1,024), typically considered relative to LoRA rank.

data.name: FineTuning.Tip.loraDropout
data.value: Adapter dropout probability (0–0.9). Backend support is validated by the worker.

data.name: FineTuning.Tip.targetModules
data.value: Use all-linear or comma-separated module names supported by the selected model and backend (maximum 512 characters).

data.name: FineTuning.Tip.warmupRatio
data.value: Fraction of training steps used for learning-rate warmup (0–0.5).

data.name: FineTuning.Tip.weightDecay
data.value: Optimizer weight-decay coefficient (0–1). Default 0 disables weight decay.

data.name: FineTuning.Tip.loggingSteps
data.value: Optimizer steps between training metric logs (1–10,000).

data.name: FineTuning.Tip.saveSteps
data.value: Optimizer steps between checkpoint saves (1–100,000). Final artifacts are reported separately by the worker.

data.name: FineTuning.Tip.evalSteps
data.value: Optimizer steps between held-out evaluations (1–100,000), including the automatic split.

data.name: FineTuning.Tip.seed
data.value: Seed (0–2,147,483,647). Repeatability still depends on backend, model and hardware.

data.name: FineTuning.Tip.maxDurationMinutes
data.value: Worker-enforced runtime limit (1–10,080 minutes), not a progress estimate.

data.name: FineTuning.Guide.Purpose
data.value: LoRA/QLoRA trains an adapter to change task behavior, style or output format. It does not replace KnowledgeBase/RAG, deploy inference, or automatically register a model.

data.name: FineTuning.Guide.Worker
data.value: Deploy the separate CPU/CUDA or native Apple Silicon Worker, provision an approved offline model, and configure the global switch, host allowlist and alias-specific secret. Add/select a Worker profile here, then read capability reasons before proceeding.

data.name: FineTuning.Guide.Data
data.value: Expand Dataset examples below to download JSONL. Replace the demonstration rows with licensed, cleaned data and upload training and validation separately. Do not train on the final test set. With no explicit validation, the Worker holds out approximately 20% of distinct rows.

data.name: FineTuning.Guide.Training
data.value: Name the job and select its model, datasets, compatible backend and LoRA/QLoRA method. Start with the default 10 optimizer steps; expand Advanced parameters for explanations and resource budgets. CPU does not support QLoRA.

data.name: FineTuning.Guide.MonitorTitle
data.value: Inspect real progress and recover safely

data.name: FineTuning.Guide.Monitor
data.value: Select a job to see actual steps, training/validation loss, resources, logs and configuration. Refresh restores retained history. A stale connection does not mean training stopped; refresh job status before retrying a timed-out submission. Cancellation is not pause/resume.

data.name: FineTuning.Guide.Publish
data.value: Download the export and inspect its manifest. Succeeded means the training process completed, not that quality passed. Compare the base and adapter on untouched tasks with identical prompts and RAG context, deploy a compatible inference runtime, then register that inference endpoint in model management.

data.name: FineTuning.Guide.Error.Connection
data.value: Disabled / missing secret / connection failure: check the global Enabled switch, a valid alias-specific key, AllowedHosts, the profile's enabled state, network namespace and Worker logs. Restart NCF after environment-variable changes, then refresh.

data.name: FineTuning.Guide.Error.Dataset
data.value: Dataset rejected: fix the reported line, field shape, UTF-8 encoding and size/row limits. Messages require the model tokenizer's chat template. Different dataset IDs do not prevent data leakage; overlapping validation rows are rejected.

data.name: FineTuning.Guide.Error.Memory
data.value: Out of memory / unstable loss: inspect the actual error and metrics, lower batch size, sequence length or rank, or choose a supported quantized backend. Create a new bounded job after correcting the cause; unavailable sensors must not be read as zero.

data.name: FineTuning.Guide.Error.Interrupted
data.value: Cancelled / interrupted / failed: inspect retained checkpoints and events. Restarted active jobs are Interrupted, not successful. This version has no automatic resume, online deletion or automatic deployment. Define backup and retention policies before production.

data.name: FineTuning.Guide.DatasetSchema
data.value: Each row uses only prompt + completion, or only messages. Text must be nonblank, at most 65,536 characters, without NUL. Messages has 2–128 role/content entries: optional system first, then alternating user/assistant, ending with assistant. No tool messages or extra fields.

data.name: FineTuning.Guide.SampleNotice
data.value: These four distinct rows demonstrate file structure only, not model quality or sufficient training data. Messages requires an approved tokenizer chat template; use prompt/completion when it has none. Downloading does not upload or submit a job.

data.name: FineTuning.Guide.SmokeNotice
data.value: The default 10 steps verify the pipeline, not production quality. Positive maxSteps overrides epochs; validation also runs at the final step.

data.name: FineTuning.Error.DatasetSchema
data.value: Unsupported dataset row structure. See Dataset examples; line:

data.name: FineTuning.WorkerNotReady

data.name: FineTuning.WorkerVersionMismatch
data.value: This console requires Worker 1.1 or newer with catalog paging and persistent storage identity. Upgrade the matching Worker before submitting jobs.

data.name: FineTuning.WorkerDisableHelp
data.value: Disabling this profile blocks administration access, not existing training. Cancel jobs first or stop the Worker using the operator procedure when termination is required.

data.name: FineTuning.WorkerSetupEmpty
data.value: No Worker profile has been added yet. Deploy the training Worker, configure its matching secret and allowed host on NCF, then use Add worker to set its alias and private endpoint. Upload and training become available after a successful connection.

data.name: FineTuning.WorkerSetupExisting
data.value: No selectable Worker is available. Edit a profile to enable it and configure a valid alias-specific secret on NCF, then refresh. This is a configuration step, not a failed training job.
